name: Garnet Toikurosu
original_name: ガーネット・トイクロス
source: A harpy who became the general of the Gurizani army after the death of the previous one during the golem war. Childhood friend of Salacia and close aide of Lucina. Usually very mature, only Quilt is able to anger her swiftly given their shared past.
